_readme: This is the configuration file for the Restaurant AI Assistant. Please update the values below with your actual credentials and settings.

_instructions.azure_openai: Get these values from your Azure OpenAI service in the Azure portal
_instructions.azure_speech: Get these values from your Azure Speech service in the Azure portal
_instructions.database: Update with your MySQL database connection details
_instructions.files: Paths to menu, restaurant info, and log files (relative to script location)
_instructions.menu_categories: Keywords used to classify menu items (can be customized)
